entities.name: Epigenes of Byzantium
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Epigenes of Byzantium was a Greek astrologer. He seems to have been an earlier supporter of astrology, which, though derided by many Greek intellectuals, came to be accepted after Alexander the Great conquered major parts of the Near East.
